title: One creative resolution for 2027: the three-line note
hook: One resolution for 2027: write three lines every time you switch an ad off.
caption:
One resolution for 2027: write three lines every time you switch an ad off.

What we expected. What we saw. What we will do next time.

Dashboards record what an ad did. They do not record what your team concluded, so the same lesson gets paid for twice.

Keep one shared sheet with one row per ad, written by whoever switches it off. Read the last ten notes before every brief.

Every ad should make the next one better. Happy new year from all of us at Galvor.

Slide 7: happy new year, start the sheet today, follow @galvor.ai.
cta: Save and start the sheet today

slides.headline: One creative resolution for 2027: *the three-line note*
slides.sub: Two minutes per ad. A year of memory by December.

slides.headline: *Plenty of data*, no memory
slides.body:
Every dashboard shows what an ad did.

Almost none records what the team concluded. So the same lesson gets paid for again, often after someone leaves.

slides.headline: *Three lines* when an ad is switched off
items: We expected: what we thought would happen
We saw: what did happen, in one number
Next time: what we will do differently

slides.headline: What a *good note* looks like
slides.body:
We expected: the founder on camera to beat the creator.

We saw: people watched longer, but each order cost more.

Next time: founder opens, creator shows the product.

slides.headline: Every ad should make the *next one better*.
slides.sub: It can only do that if someone writes down what it taught.

slides.headline: Three rules so the habit *lasts past January*
items: One shared sheet, one row per ad
Whoever switches the ad off writes the note
Read the last ten notes before every brief

slides.headline: Happy new year. *Start the sheet today.*
slides.sub: Save this and share it with your team.

notes:
TOPIC REPLACED: '7 creative resolutions for 2027' would have repeated seven other posts in this group in short form. New topic: one habit, a three-line learning note written whenever an ad is switched off. Reader: a brand or growth manager on the first working day of the year. One argument: teams lose what ads teach them because nobody writes the conclusion down. No numbers used. Slide 4 is a made-up example of the note format and is labelled 'Illustration, not real data' on the slide; keep that label. Uses two phrases from the spec on purpose: 'Plenty of data, no memory' and 'Every ad should make the next one better'.
